agents.description: Copilot SDK agent running in the local agent host process
Claude agent backed by the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK

http.proxy.title: HTTP Proxy
http.proxy.description: The proxy URL used by network requests from the Agent Host.

http.proxyKerberosServicePrincipal.title: HTTP Proxy Kerberos Service Principal
http.proxyKerberosServicePrincipal.description: The Kerberos service principal used to authenticate with the HTTP proxy.

http.noProxy.title: HTTP No Proxy
http.noProxy.description: Domain names that bypass the configured HTTP proxy.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Per-tool session permissions. Updated automatically when approving a tool "in this Session".

disableRepoInfoTelemetry.title: Disable Repository Information Telemetry
disableRepoInfoTelemetry.description: Whether repository information telemetry is disabled for Agent Host sessions.

telemetryLevel.title: Telemetry Level
telemetryLevel.description: Most restrictive telemetry level requested by connected clients.

editTelemetryEnabled.title: Edit Telemetry
editTelemetryEnabled.description: Whether edit attribution telemetry is enabled for Agent Host sessions.

sessionSyncEnabled.title: Session Sync
sessionSyncEnabled.description: Whether remote session sync is enabled for the copilot-sdk CLI.

byokModelsEnabled.title: BYOK Models
byokModelsEnabled.description: Whether extension-provided BYOK models are enabled.

codexAgentEnabled.title: Codex Agent
codexAgentEnabled.description: Whether the Codex provider is enabled.

terminalAutoApproveEnabled.title: Terminal Auto Approve
terminalAutoApproveEnabled.description: Whether terminal auto-approve rules forwarded by the connected client are allowed to apply to agent-host shell permission requests.

globalAutoApproveEnabled.title: Global Auto Approve
globalAutoApproveEnabled.description: Whether VS Code's global auto-approve setting is enabled. When `true`, every tool call is auto-approved, equivalent to a session using Allow all.

autoReplyEnabled.title: Auto Reply
autoReplyEnabled.description: Whether VS Code's auto-reply setting is enabled. When `true`, `ask_user` questions are auto-answered instead of blocking on the user, mirroring autopilot mode.

systemProxyEnabled.title: System Proxy Discovery
systemProxyEnabled.description: Whether Copilot sessions automatically discover and use the operating system's proxy configuration.

githubMcpServerEnabled.title: GitHub MCP Server
githubMcpServerEnabled.description: Whether agent sessions include a GitHub MCP server by default.

mcpConnectorsEnabled.title: Copilot Connectors
mcpConnectorsEnabled.description: Whether Copilot agent sessions expose MCP servers provided by connected Copilot Connectors.

markdownPlanRichLinksEnabled.title: Markdown Plan Rich Links
markdownPlanRichLinksEnabled.description: Whether agents receive guidance for using rich links and running task markers in Markdown plan documents.

agentOrchestrationLimits.title: Agent Orchestration Limits
agentOrchestrationLimits.description: Controls creation, messaging, and recursion safety limits for Agent Host session tools.
enumDescriptions: Do not enforce agent orchestration safety limits.

artifactTools.title: Artifact Tools
artifactTools.description: Whether agents can record artifacts — pull requests, issues, commits, websites, files and other resources — with the artifact tools.

autoAttachPullRequests.title: Automatic Pull Request Association
autoAttachPullRequests.description: Whether the Agent Host automatically discovers and associates a pull request for the currently checked-out branch. When disabled, only pull requests recorded as artifacts or explicitly associated by session actions are considered.

migrateLegacyCopilotCliEnabled.title: Migrate Legacy Copilot CLI Sessions
migrateLegacyCopilotCliEnabled.description: Whether un-adopted extension-host Copilot CLI sessions are surfaced as adoptable agent-host sessions and migrated in place when opened.

sessionCatalogEnabled.title: Session Catalog
sessionCatalogEnabled.description: Whether the session list is served from the central catalog. When disabled, sessions are listed from provider metadata and per-session storage instead.

showExternalSessions.title: Show External Agent Sessions
showExternalSessions.description: Controls whether sessions created outside the Agent Host are included in the session catalog.
enumDescriptions: Show up to the 2 most recent external sessions updated in the last 7 days. At startup, external sessions older than the second-most-recently updated local session are hidden.
Show external sessions updated in the last 24 hours.
Show external sessions updated in the last 7 days.
Show external sessions updated in the last 30 days.

autoArchiveMergedSessionsAfterDays.title: Auto-Archive Merged Sessions
autoArchiveMergedSessionsAfterDays.description: Number of inactive days after which a session with a merged pull request is automatically archived. Zero disables automatic archival.

autoDeleteArchivedMergedSessionsAfterDay.title: Auto-Delete Archived Merged Sessions
autoDeleteArchivedMergedSessionsAfterDay.description: Number of days after automatic archival before a session with a merged pull request is permanently deleted. Zero disables permanent deletion.

copilotMultiRootEnabled.title: Copilot Multiple Working Directories
copilotMultiRootEnabled.description: Whether the Copilot provider advertises support for multiple working directories, letting a session span every folder of a multi-root workspace.

claudeMultiRootEnabled.title: Claude Multiple Working Directories
claudeMultiRootEnabled.description: Whether the Claude provider advertises support for multiple working directories, letting a session span every folder of a multi-root workspace.

codexMultiRootEnabled.title: Codex Multiple Working Directories
codexMultiRootEnabled.description: Whether the Codex provider advertises support for multiple working directories, letting a session span every folder of a multi-root workspace.

editAutoApprovePatterns.title: Edit Auto Approve Patterns
editAutoApprovePatterns.description: Effective edit auto-approve patterns forwarded by the connected client for agent-host write permission checks.

terminalAutoApproveRules.title: Terminal Auto Approve Rules
terminalAutoApproveRules.description: Terminal auto-approve rules forwarded by the connected client for agent-host shell permission checks.

mcpServers.title: MCP Servers
mcpServers.description: Agent-host-level MCP servers exposed to every session, keyed by server name. Each value is a server configuration (see `<serverName>`).

<serverName>.title: MCP Server
<serverName>.description: A single MCP server entry. The property key is the server name.

type.title: Server Type
type.description: The transport used to reach the server: `stdio` for a local command, `http` for a remote endpoint.

command.title: Command
command.description: For `stdio` servers, the executable to spawn.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: For `stdio` servers, the arguments passed to the command.

env.title: Environment
env.description: For `stdio` servers, environment variables set on the spawned process.

cwd.title: Working Directory
cwd.description: For `stdio` servers, the working directory the command runs in.

url.title: URL
url.description: For `http` servers, the endpoint URL of the MCP server.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: For `http` servers, HTTP headers sent with every request.

customizations.title: Plugins
customizations.description: Plugins configured on this agent host and available to remote sessions.

defaultShell.title: Default Shell
defaultShell.description: Absolute path to the shell executable used by host-managed terminals. Normally pushed by the connected VS Code client from `terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.<os>` (falling back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.<os>`); when unset, the agent host falls back to the system shell. Only the path is supported; `args` and `env` from the workbench profile are not piped through yet. The workbench only pushes this for the local agent host — remote agent host operators should set this directly in the remote machine's `agent-host-config.json`.

allowSignedOutWhenUsable.title: Allow Signed-Out Agent Host
allowSignedOutWhenUsable.description: Experimental. When enabled, Agent Host sessions remain available while signed out as long as the selected agent has a usable model and authentication (for example Codex with ChatGPT authentication or Claude in native mode with your own Anthropic credentials). When disabled (the default), GitHub sign-in is required.

githubEnterpriseUri.title: GitHub Enterprise URI
githubEnterpriseUri.description: Optional base URI of a GitHub Enterprise instance (for example "https://ghe.example.com" for GitHub Enterprise Server, or "https://tenant.ghe.com" for GitHub Enterprise Cloud). When set, the agent host authenticates and makes GitHub API calls against this instance instead of github.com. Normally pushed by the connected VS Code client from the selected enterprise account's authorization server; remote agent host operators can set it directly in the remote `agent-host-config.json`.

enableCustomTerminalTool.title: Use Agent Host Terminal Tool
enableCustomTerminalTool.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions use Agent Host's terminal tool override instead of the SDK's default terminal behavior.

enableShellInitScript.title: Shell Init Script
enableShellInitScript.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions apply the shell init script published by the client before each shell command.

copilotSdkLogLevel.title: Copilot SDK Log Level
copilotSdkLogLevel.description: Controls logging from the Copilot SDK runtime. Agent host trace logging always enables trace output.

runtimePath.title: Copilot Runtime Path
runtimePath.description: Absolute path to a local Copilot runtime executable. Empty uses the bundled runtime.

rubberDuck.title: Rubber Duck Agent
rubberDuck.description: When enabled, the coding agent uses a rubber duck critic subagent to review code changes using a complementary model.

claudeAdvisor.title: Claude Advisor Tool
claudeAdvisor.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions using supported Claude models expose the provider-native Advisor tool.

tgrep.title: Indexed Search (tgrep)
tgrep.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions force-enable tgrep indexed search, bypassing the repository-size threshold. Requires a local Git repository on a non-virtual filesystem.

opus48Prompt.title: Opus 4.8 Agent Prompt
opus48Prompt.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions running a Claude Opus 4.8 model apply Opus 4.8-tuned system-prompt section overrides on top of the default system message.

toolSearchEnabled.title: Agent Host Tool Search
toolSearchEnabled.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions defer MCP and non-core VS Code tools behind a tool-search tool so the model discovers them on demand instead of loading every tool definition up front.

toolSearchDeferThreshold.title: Tool Search Defer Threshold
toolSearchDeferThreshold.description: Minimum number of tools before MCP and external tools are deferred behind tool search. Set to 0 to always defer external tools. Only effective when tool search is enabled.

hydraFusion.title: HydraFusion
hydraFusion.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions can use the experimental HydraFusion model.

skillCharBudget.title: Skill Character Budget
skillCharBudget.description: Maximum number of characters available for skill descriptions in the Copilot SDK system message.

autoModeTierOverride.title: Auto Optimize for Override
autoModeTierOverride.description: Overrides Auto's "Optimize for" preference. Accepts efficiency, balance, or intelligence. Applied when a session is created or resumed and when its model changes. Empty or unsupported values use the picker or service defaults.

claudeDefaultReasoningEffort.title: Claude Default Thinking Level
claudeDefaultReasoningEffort.description: Overrides the default thinking level shown in the model picker for Claude models. Empty uses the built-in default. Ignored for models that do not support the chosen level.

modelCapabilityOverrides.title: Model Capability Overrides
modelCapabilityOverrides.description: Per-model overrides for Copilot SDK sessions. Use `*` to match every model. Intended for experimentation.

additionalProperties.title: Capability Override
additionalProperties.description: A single capability override. The property key is the model id.

family.title: Family
family.description: Route the model to another family's tuned system prompt and tool profile (e.g. `claude-opus-4.8`). The model id sent to the runtime is unaffected, so the session still runs on the selected model.

reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for sessions on this model; overrides the model picker's thinking level. Unrecognized values are ignored.

availableTools.title: Available Tools
availableTools.description: When set, only matching tools are available to sessions on this model. Patterns: bare tool names, `builtin:*` or `builtin:<name>` (Copilot runtime tools), `mcp:*` or `mcp:<name>` (MCP server tools), and `custom:*` or `custom:<name>` (every tool VS Code registers with the SDK, including the agent host's own terminal tools); a bare `*` expands to all three sources. Applied when the session launches or resumes.

excludedTools.title: Excluded Tools
excludedTools.description: Tools disabled for sessions on this model; same pattern syntax as `availableTools` and takes precedence over it. Note that `custom:*` and a bare `*` also disable the agent host's own terminal tools registered with the SDK. Applied when the session launches or resumes.

modelCapabilities.title: Model Capabilities
modelCapabilities.description: Per-property model capability overrides passed through to the Copilot SDK's `modelCapabilities` session field (e.g. `{ "supports": { "vision": false }, "limits": { "max_context_window_tokens": 64000 } }`), deep-merged over the runtime's resolved defaults for this model. Applied when the session launches or resumes.

promptOverrideString.title: Prompt Override String
promptOverrideString.description: Inline YAML that overrides the system prompt and/or SDK tool descriptions for sessions on this model. Takes precedence over `promptOverrideFile`.

promptOverrideFile.title: Prompt Override File
promptOverrideFile.description: Path to a YAML file that overrides the system prompt and/or SDK tool descriptions for sessions on this model. Ignored when `promptOverrideString` is also set.

automationsEnabled.title: Automations
automationsEnabled.description: Whether this Agent Host may run automations.

automationRunTimeoutMinutes.title: Automation Run Timeout
automationRunTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum duration of an automation run, in minutes.

codex.personality.title: Personality
codex.personality.description: Controls the default communication style for Codex. Default leaves personality unset in config.toml.

codex.autoReviewPolicy.title: Auto-review policy
codex.autoReviewPolicy.description: Updates auto_review.policy in config.toml. Leave empty to remove the auto_review section.

vscode.agentCustomizationSettings.title: Codex
vscode.agentCustomizationSettings.description: Configure Codex defaults stored in config.toml. Project and managed configuration can override these user values.

configurationFile.title: Advanced configuration
configurationFile.description: Open the Codex configuration file to customize additional agent behavior.
